product.name: Regular Fit Linen-blend Shirt
product.description: Regular-fit shirt in a woven cotton and linen blend with a comfortable, classic silhouette. Turn-down collar, buttons without placket, and yoke at back. Long sleeves, sleeve placket with link button, and button at cuffs. Rounded hem. Cotton and linen blends combine the softness of cotton with the sturdiness of linen, creating a beautiful, textured fabric that is breathable and perfectly draped.

materialDetails.name: Cotton

materialDetails.name: Linen
materialDetails.description: Linen is a natural bast fiber derived from flax plants.

materialDetails.name: Recycled cotton
materialDetails.description: Recycled cotton is cotton made from textile waste in production or from end-of-life textile waste. The waste is mechanically recycled and spun into new yarn.
